name: Google Summer of Code (GSoC)
stipend: Paid (Google stipend pegged to purchasing power parity for Nigeria)
application_window: Typically February - April annually (Verify dates for 2027 cohort)
eligibility_note: Open to all students and beginners worldwide (18+), fully remote from Nigeria. Mentored contributions to major open-source organizations.
recommended_prep: Identify participating organizations (e.g. Linux Foundation, Python, Apache, Wikimedia) in December-January, join their mailing lists, and submit introductory pull requests.

name: Major League Hacking (MLH) Fellowship
application_window: Rolling admissions (Summer batch opens February - April; verify dates)
eligibility_note: 100% remote open to Nigeria. Tracks include Open Source, Software Engineering, and Web3/Production Engineering. Mentored by professional engineers.
recommended_prep: Build a strong GitHub portfolio with clean commits, review JavaScript/TypeScript fundamentals, and prepare for code walkthrough interviews.

name: Outreachy Internships
application_window: May to August (Applications open January - February; verify dates)
eligibility_note: Fully remote internship open to applicants subject to systemic bias or underrepresented in the tech industry in their country (Nigeria fully eligible).
recommended_prep: Initial application essay submission followed by the 4-week public contribution period where you submit code directly to open-source project mentors.

name: Pan Atlantic University Career Office (SIWES & Local Placements)
stipend: Varies by employer (Lagos corporate & fintech standard)
application_window: Contact PAU Career Services office during 1st/2nd semester of 3rd year
eligibility_note: Direct university partnership placement for 3rd-year B.Sc. Software Engineering students in Lagos (Ibeju-Lekki / Victoria Island / Ikeja).
recommended_prep: Book an in-person meeting with PAU career advisors. Request list of partner tech employers in Lagos (e.g. Moniepoint, Interswitch, Paystack, banks) that recruit SIWES interns.
